firie.definition:
The Australian slang term for a Fireman
> "Shit davo, the house is on fire"!
> "Better call the firies, mate"

firing.definition:
n the act of firing weapons or artillery at an enemy
n the act of discharging a gun
n the act of setting something on fire
n the termination of someone's employment (leaving them free to depart)
v start firing a weapon
v cause to go off
v bake in a kiln so as to harden
v terminate the employment of; discharge from an office or position
v go off or discharge
v drive out or away by or as if by fire
v call forth (emotions, feelings, and responses)
v destroy by fire
v provide with fuel
firing.translation:
n. 烧毁, 焚烧, 加热, 添煤
[计] 点火

firing line.translation: n. 射击线, 作战最前线

firing off.translation: na. 发射(火箭等)；发炮；使爆炸；熄灭(火)

firing range.translation: [化] 着火范围(指着火温度的范围)

firing squad.translation: n. 行刑队, 执行死刑的射击队

firings.definition:
n. the act of firing weapons or artillery at an enemy
n. the act of discharging a gun
n. the act of setting something on fire
firings.translation:
n. 开火；烧制；解雇；生火
v. 开火；烧制；解雇（fire的ing形式）；点燃；激励
n. (Firing)人名；(英)法尔林
